propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate took the client-onboarding workflow into live operation on 2 October 2023 after a signed go-live approval and ran a four-week hypercare desk.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the go-live and hypercare, and the close report carries the signed approval, the live date and the daily defect logs.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate coordinated three test cycles with client services in the test instance and triaged 41 defects.
propositions.rationale: The resume places the test cycles in the test instance.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate rewrote 18 procedures in the operations manual to match the new case stages.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the procedures work directly.

expectedGap: Weekly case counts after go-live are documented, but no before-and-after comparison of processing times is.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the live date, the signed go-live approval and the hypercare period; keep the test cycles in the test instance; do not add processing-time improvements.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask whether onboarding processing times were measured before and after the workflow change, and over what period.
